description: Every arbitrary probability and parameter of the randomizer. Each entry is {"value": ..., "description": ...}; edit the value, keep the description up to date. Loaded and checked by core/game/data/tuning.py.

resource_to_root_mb.description: Megabytes the game's Resource heap (models, textures, maps; 47 MB on an Old 3DS, 52 on a New 3DS) gives to its root heap, which the mod's added code and data take from, so a full mod boots on an Old 3DS (game/executable/memory_split.py). Every built executable gets it.

old3ds_root_margin_kb.description: Kilobytes the Old 3DS root heap must keep free after the boot with the executable's extension at its largest; tests/game/executable/test_memory_split.py fails below it (the room the ported monsters' objects take in a hunt, and what the measure may have missed).

talk_window_quest_modes.description: HUD size: the game modes (the game control's byte +0x2B, 0 to 31: 1 a quest, 5 its results, 2 the Gathering Hall) in which the talk windows shrink with the HUD; in every other mode (the villages, the Gathering Hall) they keep their full size (interface/hud/code_patch.py patch_talk_size).
